Golden outer eye diameter about 28 percent of the head height, like a cute animated character. Short small slightly pursed mouth at far left. Smooth rounded cheeks and soft black glossy head, with only subtle broad simplified scales on the body. Head and body together occupy 60 percent of the total fish length, tail occupies remaining 40 percent. The body is short and fat, black with charcoal blue glossy highlights, a dark crisp silhouette, broad rounded belly. A tall gracefully curved black dorsal fin sweeps up and backward from top of the plump body, with rounded scalloped edge and subtle fin rays. Large flowing broad black fantail at right, fan shape, complete rounded upper and lower lobes, shiny curved highlights. Small complete rounded black pectoral and pelvic fins. Cute high-end casual mobile game 3D render with soft stylized highlights, smoothly shaded forms and dark outline. Small transparent padding on all sides. No text, no bubbles, no water, no aquarium scene, no halo, no cast shadow, no realistic tiny scales or photorealism, no extra fish. All pixels outside the fish silhouette must have alpha zero.
